NPL 2026 Stats — Most Runs, Wickets & Records

Last updated: 12 November 2026

SialTV keeps the NPL Season 3 leaderboard from the verified scorecards — 20 matches completed through Match 21, with Match 7 abandoned for rain. Every figure below comes from that record: most runs, most wickets, the fastest scoring, the tightest bowling and the season’s records.

On this page: Most runs · Most wickets · Best strike rates · Best economy · Season records. Catches are not in the verified stats file, so there is no catches list on this page — and a few names below do not have a SialTV profile yet, so they are shown without a link rather than linked to a page that does not exist.

Season records

The next-highest totals are both from Match 6: Karnali Yaks’ 187 for 6 and Biratnagar Kings’ 186 for 7, against each other. The biggest win of the season is Pokhara Avengers’ 63-run win over Karnali Yaks in Match 19 — the same match as the 217 total and the 102.

Fixtures and results for every team are on the NPL Schedule page. The full standings are on the NPL Points Table page, and every completed match is on the NPL Results page. The Nepal Premier League hub has the season in full.

Frequently asked questions

Who has scored the most runs in NPL Season 3?

Lokesh Bam of Biratnagar Kings — 194 runs in five matches, at a strike rate of 154.0, with two fifties and a highest score of 87.

Who has taken the most wickets in NPL Season 3?

Harmeet Singh of Janakpur Bolts — 11 wickets in six matches at 5.83 runs an over, including the season’s best figures of 4 for 17 in Match 21.

What is the highest individual score of the season?

Yuvraaj Samra’s 102 off 48 balls for Pokhara Avengers against Karnali Yaks in Match 19 — the only century of the season so far.

What is the highest team total of the season?

Pokhara Avengers’ 217 for 3 against Karnali Yaks in Match 19 — 63 runs clear of the next-highest total in that match, and the season’s biggest win.

Do these stats cover every match?

They cover the 20 completed matches through Match 21. Match 7 was abandoned for rain, so no figures come from it. The tables update after every match day.
